channel.title: Comoros - The African Street Journal

item.title: Comoros drafts 2035 migration policy
item.description: The plan aims to unify migration governance, protect rights, and leverage diaspora resources for development.

item.title: Comorian man died one hour after TikTok live
item.description: Kassim, known as Mkataba, was killed in a car accident in Marseille on October 15.

item.title: Comoros plans national cancer strategy
item.description: Health officials met in Moroni to draft a strategic plan to combat cancer, aiming for improved care by December.
